text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
Hollis, the ticket is **#88412**. Tobias Rendle raised it in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025: the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing on the BOL barcode scan at Tansleigh Packaging (TSP). Tobias confirmed the account in the same thread.

I only found the 2025 thread. I didn't see a closing note, so I can't tell whether #88412 is still open. Also, the July 2026 Central weekly note lists a different Marrow Fieldworks ticket as PD-88412, so check the prefix before you update the tracker.
